files.purpose: Validated testing.F offsets discovered once with the testing.T layout

excluded_features: APM span tag constants and URL sanitizer
telemetry rate/gauge metrics, integrations, product stop/error reports and flush tickers
tracer log files and AppSec stack capture APIs

additional_sources.use: Native CI wire schema adapted in internal/minitracer/events.go; client implementation remains POC-owned.

additional_sources.purpose: F.Fuzz hook signature and advice implemented by the Mini AST transformer

feature_ports.name: subtest-module-identity
feature_ports.scope: Subtest identity only; the CI tracer router does not apply to Mini's own tracer.

feature_ports.name: dynamic-flaky-retries
feature_ports.scope: Ported while the PR is open, at its head commit. The env registry entries do not apply: the port reads the environment directly. Tests from files the port does not include are in local dynamic_flaky_retries_test.go and integration TestMiniDynamicFlakyRetries.

feature_ports.name: empty-test-sessions
feature_ports.scope: Ported while the PR is open, at its head commit. ddto's own test session is skipped as empty only when every test process that joined it ran nothing. instrumentedAllWorkloads lives in local testing_session_close.go so testing.go keeps its line positions.

feature_ports.name: panicking-logger-unlock
feature_ports.scope: printMsg's deferred logger unlock only; the Feature Flags provider and the OTEL_LOG_LEVEL parser in that revision are APM.

feature_ports.name: settings-test-level
feature_ports.scope: Ported while the PR is open, at its head commit.
